title: Sales OTE & Commission Analyzer
description: Gross W-2 model for a sales OTE offer: base plus variable as a function of quota attainment, with an optional accelerator tier and an optional recoverable draw. Reports the base commission rate, the at-target variable and total, a flat-rate after-tax figure, the base/variable split with a risk label, a six-level attainment scenario ladder, and draw payback in months with a clawback-elevated flag. Models gross pay only: no tax liability, no FLSA regular rate, no overtime. Refuses ote <= base and base <= 0 with named reasons. Every input is read with the Apex `||` default semantics, so an explicit 0 is replaced by a default and reported in apex_zero_coercion_applied.

as_of.description: Calendar date as YYYY-MM-DD, a real calendar date. The node reads no clock; this is the only date the kernel sees (APEXPORT-110B as-of pattern). Invalid dates are refused REFUSED_BAD_AS_OF. Does not select a tax table in v1: see scope_note.

base_salary.description: Annual base salary in USD. Must be strictly positive and strictly less than ote; otherwise the run is refused BASE_NOT_POSITIVE or OTE_NOT_ABOVE_BASE, in that order. Apex pages read this control with `parseFloat(v) || 0`, so an explicit 0 is coerced to the default 0 and refused anyway.

ote.description: On-Target Earnings in USD: the total target W-2, base plus variable at 100% quota attainment. Must exceed base_salary strictly; equal is refused OTE_NOT_ABOVE_BASE.

quota.description: Annual quota in USD. Quoted for the displayed base commission rate (ote - base_salary)/quota. It does NOT scale any dollar output: the accelerated branch multiplies excess revenue by a commission rate whose denominator is quota, so quota cancels algebraically. Coerced to 1 when 0.

attainment_pct.description: Current-year quota attainment in percent, a plain number (100 = 100%). Does not change the at-target column, which is always computed at exactly 100%. It selects which scenario row is highlighted, via Math.round(attainment_pct/25)*25. Coerced to 100 when 0.

federal_tax_rate_pct.description: Flat federal rate in percent applied to gross W-2 to produce after_tax_at_target. NOT A TAX COMPUTATION: one flat caller rate, no standard deduction, no bracket stacking, no state tax, no FICA. The 2026 marginal schedule (Rev. Proc. 2025-32 sec. 4.01) is recorded in the kernel as named literals but not applied. Coerced to 32 when 0.

has_accelerator.description: True to apply the accelerator tier. When false the two accelerator fields below are still read (Apex reads them unconditionally) but never affect any output.

accelerator_threshold_pct.description: Attainment percent above which the commission rate is multiplied by accelerator_multiplier. The switch is `attainment <= accelerator_threshold_pct`, so the accelerator is STRICTLY inactive at exactly the threshold. Always evaluated at 100% for the at-target column. Coerced to 100 when 0.

accelerator_multiplier.description: Multiplier applied to the base commission rate on revenue above the threshold, e.g. 1.5 = 150%. Read unconditionally but only applied when has_accelerator is true and the attainment strictly exceeds the threshold. Coerced to 1.5 when 0.

has_draw.description: True to model a recoverable draw against future commissions. When false the draw block is absent entirely and draw_monthly is read but unused.

draw_monthly.description: Monthly draw advance in USD. Applied only when has_draw is true AND draw_monthly > 0. Annual draw is draw_monthly * 12. Coerced to 0 when 0, which silently disables the block.

output_schema.description: output_payload: as_of, the nine echoed inputs plus has_accelerator/has_draw, base_commission_rate, variable_at_target, total_w2_at_target, after_tax_at_target, base_split_pct, variable_split_pct, risk_label, risk_rank, accelerator_insight{attainment_pct,variable,total_w2,threshold_pct,multiplier}|null, attainment_scenarios[]{attainment_pct,variable,total_w2,after_tax,vs_ote_pct,meets_or_exceeds_ote,highlighted}, draw{applies,draw_monthly,annual_draw,monthly_variable_at_target,months_to_payback,months_to_payback_rounded_1dp,payback_computable,clawback_elevated}|null, apex_zero_coercion_applied[], refusal_reason, domain_errors[], flsa_commission_basis, scope_note, constants_version.

input_schema_provenance: Top-level properties are exactly the policy_parameters members the kernel reads, one property per input: as_of, base_salary, ote, quota, attainment_pct, federal_tax_rate_pct, has_accelerator, accelerator_threshold_pct, accelerator_multiplier, has_draw, draw_monthly. All eleven are listed required because the kernel dereferences all eleven unconditionally on every run (the Apex page reads every control, including the accelerator and draw fields, before any branch). The numeric `type` on each is the type the kernel actually reads it as (Number / boolean) — none is asserted from a label.

output_example.flsa_commission_basis: 29 CFR 778.117 (commission payments are payments for hours worked and must be included in the regular rate)
output_example.scope_note: Models the gross W-2 of an OTE offer only: base salary plus variable pay as a function of quota attainment, with an optional accelerator tier and an optional recoverable draw. It computes NO tax liability: after_tax_at_target is gross W-2 times a single caller-supplied flat federal rate, which ignores the standard deduction and the 2026 marginal bracket schedule in Rev. Proc. 2025-32 sec. 4.01 (recorded above as named literals, not applied). No state tax, no FICA, no pre-tax deductions, no benefits load. It computes NO FLSA regular rate and NO overtime: see FLSA_COMMISSION_BASIS and cross-reference node art-340-compute-flsa-regular-rate, and note the duty test at 29 CFR 541.500. The risk labels (high/moderate/low at 60%/40% of OTE in variable pay), the 6-month clawback threshold and the 25-point highlight bucket are the Apex tool's own editorial constants with no cited source; they are not regulatory. The draw/clawback figures are arithmetic on the caller-supplied draw, not a reading of any offer letter or of wage law. NOT TAX ADVICE, NOT WAGE-HOUR LEGAL ADVICE, NOT COMPENSATION ADVICE.
